# agentops_skill (Resource)

An authored skill in the Skills Registry: a versioned Markdown document an agent can be attached to. Requires the account-level `skills_registry` feature; mutations return 404 while it is disabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An authored skill: a versioned Markdown document agents can be attached to.
# Setting `content` on create publishes version 1; editing it and re-applying
# publishes a new version and bumps the computed `content_version`.
resource "agentops_skill" "deploy_runbook" {
  name        = "deploy-runbook"
  description = "How to safely roll out a service"

  content = <<-EOT
    # Deploy runbook

    Roll out changes in stages, verifying health before widening the blast radius.

    1. Deploy to the canary and watch error rate for 10 minutes.
    2. If healthy, roll out to 25%, 50%, then 100%.
    3. On any regression, roll back to the previous version.
  EOT

  tags = ["ops", "deploy"]
  labels = {
    team = "platform"
  }
}

# For a real skill, keep the body in a file and let a change to it publish a new
# version: content = file("${path.module}/skills/deploy-runbook.md")
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable skill name. Must be unique within the account.

### Optional

- `content` (String) Markdown body of the skill. Setting it on create publishes version 1; changing it afterwards publishes a new version.
- `description` (String) Free-form description. When `content` carries a front-matter `description`, the control plane derives this field from it instead.
- `labels` (Map of String) Arbitrary key/value labels used for ABAC scoping.
- `tags` (List of String) Free-form tags for organising skills.

### Read-Only

- `content_version` (Number) Latest published content version number, or null when no content has been published.
- `id` (String) Skill identifier.
- `kind` (String) Skill kind. Terraform-managed skills are always `authored`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Skills are imported by their id.
terraform import agentops_skill.deploy_runbook skl_01hxyz
```
